Parameter_Or_Limit_Name: Infant Acoustic Sound Pressure Upper Limit
Actual_Original_Source: Conflation of competitor motorized cradle noise (65-75dBA in majn_lean_mvp/01_core_research_brief.md) or misreading of Hugh et al. 2014 sleep machine study
Engineering_Critique_And_Risk: AAP (American Academy of Pediatrics) recommends ambient noise in infant sleep/NICU environments must NOT exceed 50 dBA. 75 dBA at 10cm from infant ear is equivalent to a vacuum cleaner and causes acoustic trauma, hearing threshold shifts, and chronic infant distress.
Action_Required: REJECT 75 dBA target immediately. Re-anchor safety limit to AAP standard: Continuous soothing sound <= 50.0 dBA at infant head position (TP-09), absolute emergency peak <= 65.0 dBA.

Actual_Original_Source: Unit and concept conflation: Kimura et al. 2017 studied 0.5 Hz rocking frequency and insensible 10-15um micro-vibrations on adult mechanical beds (conflated in 마중_차량수면과학_인증규제_정리_2026-07-21.md)
Engineering_Critique_And_Risk: 0.5g acceleration at 45Hz corresponds to 61um displacement (violent buzzing vibration, not insensible). At 0.5Hz, 0.5g would require 50cm displacement. Kimura examined insensible 10-15um micro-vibration. Adult mechanical bed dynamics cannot be applied to infant bassinet without mechanical transfer function.
Action_Required: REJECT 0.5g as approved safety limit. Characterize mechanical transfer function from exciter to mattress. Target true insensible micro-vibration: a_RMS <= 0.05g - 0.15g (displacement 10-15um).

Actual_Original_Source: Arbitrary developer heuristic note in docs/FAULT_MATRIX.md ('영유아/외력에 의한 1.5g 초과 충격')
Engineering_Critique_And_Risk: Lacks clinical or biomechanical justification. Normal infant movements (vigorous kicking, coughing, startle reflex) or gentle parental contact easily exceed 1.5g peak on a rigid PCB, causing nuisance false-positive shutdowns. Conversely, slow tip-over might not trigger 1.5g until impact.
Action_Required: Demote from 'Approved Requirement' to 'Experimental Heuristic'. Perform drop, handling, and infant dummy vibration tests to establish scientifically validated impact thresholds.

Engineering_Critique_And_Risk: At 1.25W power dissipation with QFN-14 package (theta_JA = 45 C/W), delta_T is 56 C. At Ta = 40 C ambient inside sealed bassinet enclosure, Tj reaches 96-105 C and Tc reaches 80-85 C. Compliant with 125 C silicon limit but leaves narrow margin under summer conditions.
Action_Required: Conduct FLIR thermal measurement (TP-08) at 40 C ambient chamber. Maximize PCB copper thermal ground planes and via stitching under U3.

Claimed_Origin: TI TAS5805M Datasheet (OTW = 135 C; OTS = 165 C)
Engineering_Critique_And_Risk: HTSSOP-28 package with bottom PowerPAD soldered to 4-layer GND plane has theta_JA = 28 C/W. At 0.8W dissipation, delta_T = 22 C. At Ta = 40 C, Tc = 62 C <= 75 C. Feasible provided thermal vias under PowerPAD are void-free.
Action_Required: Verify solder coverage on bottom PowerPAD via X-ray inspection. Measure Tc under full 60-minute continuous dual-channel playback (TP-08).

Actual_Original_Source: Arbitrary assumption without thermal resistance model
Engineering_Critique_And_Risk: SOT-23-5 package has extreme thermal resistance theta_JA = 250 C/W. At P_diss = (5.0V - 3.3V) * 0.18A = 0.306W, delta_T = 76.5 C! Even at Ta = 25 C bench, Tc = 101.5 C (grossly violates 70 C limit). At Ta = 40 C or during Wi-Fi streaming (240mA, P_diss = 0.41W), Tj exceeds 140 C, causing thermal destruction or continuous shutdown.
Action_Required: REDESIGN MANDATORY FOR PCB #0006: Replace SOT-23-5 LDO with SOT-89 package (theta_JA = 100 C/W) or migrate 3.3V rail to a high-efficiency synchronous step-down buck converter (e.g. SY8088).

Parameter_Or_Limit_Name: Plastic Housing Outer Touch Surface Temperature
Claimed_Origin: IEC 62368-1 / IEC 60601-1 Medical Infant Contact Limit
Engineering_Critique_And_Risk: Mandatory infant safety requirement. Surfaces accessible to neonates or caregivers must not exceed 40.0 C - 43.0 C to prevent contact burns and infant thermal distress. Heat conduction from PCB mount screws to bassinet bottom plate must be analyzed.
Action_Required: Maintain strict 40.0 C limit. Verify thermal barrier and air gap between PCB #0006 and baby bassinet mattress.
